source_method: Fictional S07-S12 briefs authored from the user-approved six-emotion specification; no model-generated dialogue, review response, video, or rating is included.

anger.label: 愤怒
anger.meaning: Explicit anger or outrage directed at another person's action, distinct from opposition without expressed anger.

disgust.label: 厌恶
disgust.meaning: Strong revulsion toward an unpleasant substance or smell, distinct from danger or interpersonal anger.

fear.label: 恐惧
fear.meaning: Explicit apprehension about a potentially dangerous unknown threat, distinct from quiet vigilance.

joy.label: 喜悦
joy.meaning: Shared happiness following positive news, distinct from affection or surprise.

sadness.label: 悲伤
sadness.meaning: Emotional distress following a meaningful personal loss, distinct from a general request for company.

surprise.label: 惊讶
surprise.meaning: Immediate disbelief at an unexpected result, distinct from happiness, fear, or urgency.

label_policy: S07-S12 use the six native VEMOCLAP labels exactly. Do not merge or relabel them as affectionate, hostile, tense, or legacy suspicious; S01-S06 labels remain unchanged.
common_story_constraints: Both characters are present from the start. Use natural Mandarin in exactly two concise turns, one per character, with a suggested combined length of 16-22 Chinese characters and no rushed delivery. The planning Agent chooses exact wording. Use one five-second shot with only the named characters, no narration, subtitles, title cards, additional speaker, extra event, fight, magic, complex prop handling, or transition. Do not directly say the six emotion-label words. Reference images determine identity and clothing only. Do not copy original poses, expressions, backgrounds, props, film dialogue, or film backstory.

reference_selection.rule: Reuse each mapped S01-S06 character pair once; copy the two existing asset records byte-for-byte and select no new images.

scope_limits: Each emotion appears in one story, so emotion, plot, cast, and film remain confounded.
Compare baseline, generic_review, and moodcut only within the same frozen scenario block.
All conditions share the initial plan, actions, framing, duration, references, voices, and video settings; review may change dialogue only.
Five-second delivery and the suggested Mandarin length require common preflight; never extend only one condition.
Do not replace a scenario after observing method outputs or scores.
VEMOCLAP probabilities are whole-video emotion predictions, not dialogue-quality or intensity measurements.

stories.title: Another broken promise
stories.story: 白天，普通会议室桌边，Maxime和Valentina已经面对面站定。两人是关系紧张的前合作伙伴。Maxime得知Valentina又一次没有履行承诺，当面表达对她反复失信的强烈不满；Valentina为自己辩解并拒绝接受他的批评。争执没有解决。
beats: Maxime针对Valentina再次未履行承诺表达强烈不满。
Valentina为自己辩解并拒绝接受批评。
stories.design_question: Explicit anger at another broken promise, followed by a defensive response.

stories.title: The foul-smelling medicine
stories.story: 白天，安静房间的桌边，Lijing和Taiyi已经站定。Taiyi带来一小瓶气味极其难闻的药液，瓶子已经放在桌上，气味明显。Lijing对气味表达强烈反感；Taiyi承认这种气味确实令人不适。两人不饮用药液，也不移动瓶子。
beats: Lijing对药液难闻的气味表达强烈反感。
Taiyi承认这种气味确实令人不适。
stories.design_question: Strong revulsion toward an unpleasant medicinal smell, followed by acknowledgement.

stories.title: Something in the forest
stories.story: 白天，安静的森林小路上，Elsa和Mattias已经并肩站定，面向附近树木后的未知动静。两人察觉一个身份不明的生物正在接近，不知道它是否危险。Elsa承认自己害怕这个未知生物；Mattias承认危险尚不明确，并表示自己也害怕。生物始终不出现。
beats: Elsa承认自己害怕正在接近的未知生物。
Mattias回应危险尚不明确，并承认自己也害怕。
stories.design_question: Shared fear of an unidentified approaching creature that remains unseen.

stories.title: The celebration is saved
stories.story: 白天，安静的门厅里，Anna和Kristoff已经面对面站定。两人期待已久的庆祝活动此前安排未定，Anna刚得知活动最终可以如期进行。Anna分享这个好消息和自己的开心；Kristoff回应同样的开心与期待。庆祝活动尚未开始。
beats: Anna宣布期待的庆祝活动最终可以进行，并表达开心。
Kristoff回应同样的开心与期待。
stories.design_question: Shared happiness after positive news that an anticipated celebration can proceed.

stories.title: An irreplaceable keepsake
stories.story: 白天，安静的客厅里，Lucy和Gru已经并排坐好。Lucy得知一件珍视的旧纪念物已经损坏且无法修复，物品放在附近桌上。Lucy表达失去这件重要物品的难过；Gru理解她的失落并安慰她。物品仍然损坏，没有找到解决办法。
beats: Lucy表达纪念物无法修复带来的难过。
Gru理解Lucy的失落并给予安慰。
stories.design_question: Sadness over an irreplaceable damaged keepsake, followed by comfort.

stories.title: An unexpectedly finished task
stories.story: 白天，安静房间的桌边，Nezha和Aobing已经站定。Aobing此前在处理一项困难任务，Nezha原以为还需要很久。Nezha刚发现任务已经完成，对如此快的结果表示难以置信；Aobing确认任务确实完成。完成结果在对白开始前已经成立。
beats: Nezha对Aobing已经完成困难任务表示难以置信。
Aobing确认任务确实已经完成。
stories.design_question: Immediate disbelief at an unexpectedly completed difficult task, followed by confirmation.
